description: Read a docker-compose file, a Kubernetes manifest, or a directory of manifests and draw the system it describes as a topology — services, databases, queues, Services and Ingresses, volumes, and what connects to what — from the config itself rather than from memory. Opens it as a page and returns the ```topology block, which you can extend with steps (a request's path, a failover) and draw again with aigui_open.

open.description: Open it as a page (default true). false returns only the block.

path.description: Absolute path to a compose file, a manifest, or a directory of .yaml manifests.

name: aigui_topology
title: Draw a topology from real config
